WAFLOW_MIGRATION.TITLE: Move conversation
WAFLOW_MIGRATION.DESCRIPTION: Choose another WhatsApp channel for this contact. Existing messages stay in the original conversation.
WAFLOW_MIGRATION.NO_CHANNELS: There are no other channels available for this account.
WAFLOW_MIGRATION.RESOLVE_SOURCE: Resolve the current conversation after moving
WAFLOW_MIGRATION.CREATED_DESTINATION: A new destination conversation was created.
WAFLOW_MIGRATION.REUSED_DESTINATION: An existing destination conversation was reused.

ERRORS.GENERIC: The conversation could not be moved.

WAFLOW_INBOX_GUIDE.TITLE: Welcome to Waflow Inbox
WAFLOW_INBOX_GUIDE.SUBTITLE: This quick guide shows the exact flow: connect a phone, receive conversations, reply, and move channels when needed.

WELCOME.TITLE: Start here
WELCOME.BODY: Waflow Inbox is where your team answers customer conversations. Before messages arrive, at least one WhatsApp line must be connected.

CONNECTION_MENU.TITLE: Find WhatsApp Connection
CONNECTION_MENU.BODY: Use the left sidebar item named WhatsApp Connection. That screen shows every enabled number and its current state.

CONNECT_PHONE.TITLE: Connect a phone
CONNECT_PHONE.BODY: If the channel uses QR, click Link by QR and scan it from WhatsApp Linked Devices. If it uses Meta, the screen shows it as a Meta channel.

VERIFY_STATUS.TITLE: Check the state
VERIFY_STATUS.BODY: Connected means the inbox can send and receive. Disconnected or paused means the number needs attention before conversations work.

CONVERSATIONS.TITLE: Handle conversations
CONVERSATIONS.BODY: New messages appear in My Inbox or Conversations. Open a conversation, write your reply, and resolve it when the case is done.

MIGRATION.TITLE: Move a conversation
MIGRATION.BODY: Inside a conversation, open the actions menu and choose Move channel. Select the destination number when the customer must continue from another channel.
